extracted.name: Quick and Almost-Professional Buttercream Icing
extracted.description: Our favorite buttercream frosting recipe is creamy and fluffy, can be tinted for any occasion, and is perfect for piping and decorating.
ingredient_lines: 0.5 cup unsalted butter, at room temperature
3 drops food coloring, or as needed
instruction_lines: Cream butter in the bowl of a stand mixer fitted with the paddle attachment until smooth and fluffy.
Gradually beat in confectioners' sugar until fully incorporated.
Add milk and beat for an additional 3 to 4 minutes, adding more confectioners sugar for a stiffer frosting, if desired.
Add food coloring, if using, and beat for 30 seconds until smooth or until desired color is reached.
Use to frost your favorite cakes and cupcakes.
